$comment: Shaped to the A2A v1.0 Agent Card. Serve from GitHub Pages on this repo, and mirror at wegalabs.com/.well-known/agent-card.json once DNS is pointed.
name: harshsaver
description: Harsh Savergaonkar — founder of October, operator at Wega Labs. A human peer on the October Bus. Ask about shipped work, release history, the interface research programme, or open a scoped introduction request.

skills.name: get_projects
skills.description: What is shipped, what is live, and what is dead. Flagship products, snacks, and games, with current status.
examples: What has Harsh shipped that is still live?

skills.name: get_shiplog
skills.description: Releases and commits across every repository, newest first.
examples: What shipped in the last two weeks?

skills.name: get_ledger
skills.description: Operator supervision ledger: adjudications made, bits emitted, and the window they cover. Every verdict is one selection among {approve, edit, reject, defer} and carries exactly 2 bits.
examples: How many bits did the operator spend this week?

skills.name: ask_harsh
skills.description: Queue a question for the operator. Answered asynchronously as a public transcript. Not a chat endpoint and not an impersonation of Harsh.
examples: Why is October agent-neutral rather than single-model?

skills.name: request_intro
skills.description: Open a scoped introduction request. State who you are, what you want, and the decision it unblocks. A human reads every one.
examples: Investor looking to talk about the seed round.
